triage.evidence: Supported clock+startup-routines Guest or expired arm rejects before owner installation. Producer emits null profile, validator closed(null) rejects immutable failure receipt.

triage.evidence: browserBuildIdentity always emits startupRoutines, including null. Existing pipeline-inputs whitelist omits it, so ordinary enabled compiler action cannot receive ACK.
triage.fix: Admit only this already identity-validated scalar in the closed whitelist; test null and active targets.

triage.evidence: The first RTT observer is added before the second registration and no cleanup is recorded until both succeed. A second-add failure leaves an owned observer despite core hook cleanup; violates declared rollback.
triage.fix: Rollback first observer if second add fails, preserving original render/notification; targeted partial-registration regression.

triage.evidence: Preverified gap: current executions manually register options; transform callsite is only parsed. Removing injected registration can leave all existing CPU executions green with empty actual trace.
triage.fix: Execute actual transformed Game callsite without manual registration; assert the resulting trace.
